behavior: After the archive is fully staged and checked, and any existing same-version directory is verified, atomically record inactive ownership for an ID absent from BOTH active and inactive maps, before directory promotion.

Initial ownership failure cleans staging and leaves no newly promoted payload. Promotion/final activation failure retains a listed inactive entry; retry install, explicit activation or cleanup remains possible.

An existing active ID is never deactivated to perform an upgrade. Failed final activation leaves its original index and original version bytes untouched; new version remains available for explicit verified activation.
Existing inactive IDs retain ownership of the entire ID subtree. Invalid/unverified staging never claims ownership.
